bb9c27a1: ;
 ;Main routine entry point. Prints a header for the current report
 ;then enters a loop through the contents of the VAS array
 ;assembled by the preceding routine. Each element is printed
 ;after a line manager code is executed based on contents of DGJTL.
 ;The loop is exited if the user flags DGU=1.
 ;
7a25c4a2: ;Exit current element evaluation if user flags DGU=1
